summary: Prudential plc furnished a 6-K reporting daily open-market repurchases under its existing buyback programmes announced 6 January 2026 and 2 September 2026, executed via JP Morgan Securities plc on the London Stock Exchange. Between 21 and 25 September 2026 the company bought 3,930,109 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average of roughly 9.58 GBP, with prices of 9.4080-9.8240 GBP per share. Shares will be cancelled, leaving 2,481,844,895 in issue. Cumulative programme purchases total 72,102,074 shares at 1,065.2297 pence VWAP. Watch execution pace versus capital-generation guidance and any HK Code restrictions.
